body.name: Imported sharp endpoint map and total extension
body.construction: For every \(q\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal J}\), define \(\bar\Phi(q)=\{\bar N_L(q)/\bar M(q),\bar N_U(q)/\bar M(q)\}\) when \(\bar M(q)>0\), and \(\bar\Phi(q)=(0,1)\) otherwise; set \(\Phi_{\mathrm{ext}}=\bar\Phi\). The accepted \(\text{pid\_slate\_benefit\_partialtransport}\) sharp exact-mass threshold theorem, cited as AcceptedSlateBenefit2026, supplies the identification substrate: for every \(q=p_Q\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), \(M(q)=\bar M(q)\ge m_*\), \(\Phi(q)=\Phi_{\mathrm{ext}}(q)=(L(q),U(q))\), \(L(q)=\bar N_L(q)/\bar M(q)\), and \(U(q)=\bar N_U(q)/\bar M(q)\).
